columns.summary: Female: trousers, then a tee worn out over them, and boots. Relaxed.
The same outfit in the guard: elbows and knees bent, the garments bend with them.
Male: a long-sleeved shirt tucked into trousers (shirt first, trousers over its hem), boots.
Male, tuned broad and heavy (shoulders, waist, limbs up): a tee and shorts re-fit the body; guard.
